A successful canary isn’t just about “Did the release pass?”

For QA leaders, the bigger questions are:
→ Are fewer defects escaping into production?
→ Are we detecting failures faster?
→ Can we trust the automated signals guiding rollout decisions?
→ Can we expand releases without increasing risk?

That’s why metrics like defect escape rate and mean time to detect (MTTD) matter beyond a single release.

Our latest blog takes a closer look at canary testing; from rollout mechanics and rollback thresholds to the role of automated test suites in making releases safer.
Because shipping faster only matters when you can ship safely.
